integrity: The finite test program corroborates the symbolic tree argument; no external or independent mathematical validation has been performed. Publication priority remains subject to unindexed permutation/record literature.
scientific_limitations: The exact law holds for finite rooted forests with upper Alexandrov topology and independent, identically distributed atomless atomic values. It makes no assertion about arbitrary posets with overlapping upper cones, distributions with ties or dependence, global extremality over all tree shapes, or general modal completeness.
title: A tree collision law for additivity of affine modal envelopes
